Authoritative receipts must match an exact T10-prepared transaction; unsolicited receipts fail closed
Request-scoped authority transaction keys preserve authoritative debit idempotency independently of caller labels
R12 bounded history retains only latest completed receipt per target; repeated preview/reject stress adds no history
512 targets / 1024 two-stage transactions pass with exactly 512 retained receipts and exact snapshot round-trip
258-recipe neutral catalog and branching fixtures remain bounded and deterministic

resolved_isolated_defects.defect: Initial commit_transform advanced world state before the simulation-authoritative resource debit was confirmed.
resolved_isolated_defects.risk: A debit failure or crash could split inventory state from world transformation state.
resolved_isolated_defects.repair: Converted to two-phase prepare -> simulation debit -> T10 receipt validation -> world advancement; pending transactions persist and replay idempotently.
resolved_isolated_defects.verification: Formal domain, crash/recovery and fixture integration suites pass.

resolved_isolated_defects.defect: Presentation could have trusted a merely simulation-shaped receipt before T10 accepted it.
resolved_isolated_defects.risk: Visual completion could get ahead of authoritative world state.
resolved_isolated_defects.repair: Presentation completion requires a receipt stamped accepted_by_world_transform by T10.
resolved_isolated_defects.verification: Raw simulation receipts are rejected by the completion lifecycle test; T10-accepted receipts complete successfully.

resolved_isolated_defects.defect: Two different transaction IDs could be prepared against the same target revision before the first receipt returned.
resolved_isolated_defects.risk: Both intents could debit resources even though only one world-state receipt could later win.
resolved_isolated_defects.repair: Enforced one in-flight transaction per target and reject later target transactions with target_transaction_pending until the first resolves.
resolved_isolated_defects.verification: Fixture integration proves the second same-target request is rejected before the simulation debit count changes.

resolved_isolated_defects.defect: A well-formed simulation receipt for a transaction T10 never prepared could be accepted.
resolved_isolated_defects.risk: Out-of-band authoritative-looking input could advance T10 world state.
resolved_isolated_defects.repair: accept_authoritative_receipt requires the exact transaction in prepared and exact prepared-intent field equality.
resolved_isolated_defects.verification: Fixture integration rejects unsolicited valid-looking simulation receipts with missing_prepared_transaction.

resolved_isolated_defects.defect: Initial lifecycle capture harness used untyped local inference from dynamically typed engine calls and failed GDScript parsing.
resolved_isolated_defects.risk: Rendered evidence could not be produced even though domain/integration gates passed.
resolved_isolated_defects.repair: Added explicit Dictionary typing for preview, intent and accepted receipt locals.
resolved_isolated_defects.verification: Exact-source software-Vulkan/mobile capture produces the verified lifecycle evidence.

resolved_isolated_defects.defect: The first completed-transaction design retained every full receipt indefinitely.
resolved_isolated_defects.risk: Receipt/event history grew linearly with transaction count and violated frozen R12 bounded-history requirements.
resolved_isolated_defects.repair: Added request-scoped authority_transaction_key semantics and prune completed history to the latest accepted receipt per target.
resolved_isolated_defects.verification: 5000 previews plus 5000 rejected commits add zero history; 1024 successful transforms across 512 targets retain exactly 512 receipts and round-trip component state exactly.

resolved_isolated_defects.defect: The first device-matrix evidence gate required all twelve rendered PNG hashes to be globally unique.
resolved_isolated_defects.risk: Two valid matrix rows sharing the same logical viewport could create a false CI failure.
resolved_isolated_defects.repair: Allow pixel duplicates only when both logical size and lifecycle state are identical; still require preview/committing distinction per device and reject cross-size/cross-state duplicates.
resolved_isolated_defects.verification: Corrected matrix gate passes all six project configurations and twelve exact-size renders.

resolved_isolated_defects.defect: The first native-4K detail camera was too tight and clipped the state title in all lifecycle states.
resolved_isolated_defects.risk: Critic evidence would look incomplete/sloppy despite correct underlying T10 geometry/state.
resolved_isolated_defects.repair: Moved/widened the detail camera while preserving close geometry inspection and regenerated all native-4K evidence.
resolved_isolated_defects.verification: Exact-source 30-frame native-4K gate passes and internal pixel review confirms title/disclaimer are fully inside the repaired detail frames for all five states.

resolved_isolated_defects.defect: The recipe parser accepted arbitrary rows independently and did not validate whole-catalog progression cycles or explicit reversible/inverse semantics.
resolved_isolated_defects.risk: Future content could register undeclared downgrade/cycle paths or malformed inverse relationships, violating R01/R07 progression integrity.
resolved_isolated_defects.repair: Added whole-catalog graph validation. Reversible recipes require reciprocal inverse metadata with exactly reversed endpoints; reversible state pairs are collapsed and every ordinary edge between groups must form an acyclic graph. Added fail-closed validation for malformed/duplicate recipe metadata and transactional catalog reconfiguration.
resolved_isolated_defects.verification: 154/154 exact-source domain/adversarial checks pass, including duplicate/malformed recipe rejection, undeclared 2-state/3-state cycle rejection, nonreciprocal/wrong-endpoint inverse rejection, valid forward+inverse execution, and rollback after failed cyclic reconfiguration.
